title: Cryogenic Survival
description: At 94 K the trick is not to make heat but to keep it. Unlocks the Heated Pressure Suit and the Hydrophobic Coating that keeps methane rain out of its lining.

puzzle.goal: Heat leaks through a slab of insulation of thermal conductivity k, area A and thickness l, with a difference T between the temperatures of its faces. Write the heat flow q.
puzzle.name: Fourier's law
puzzle.ask: Find q in watts through a suit's aerogel lining: k = @{k} W/m·K, A = @{A} m², T = @{T} K (310 K inside, 94 K outside), l = @{l} m.
puzzle.method: The flow is proportional to the temperature gradient, T/l, and to the area it crosses.
